item.title: T12 Engineering’s Modular Subsea Structure Enters Fabrication Phase
item.description: T12 Engineering’s gravity-based subsea structure (GBS), designed for an independent Norwegian oil and gas operator, has moved into the fabrication phase. The 60-tonne subsea structure, with a footprint of 59 m², will support mission-critical equipment in the Norwegian Sea.

item.title: SUT’s Mick Cook Offshore Site Investigation Award Won by Fugro’s Nick Ramsey
item.description: The announcement was made at Oceanology International (Oi26) in London that Nick Ramsey, Fugro’s GeoConsulting Leader – East Australia was the winner of the Society for Underwater Technology’s (SUT) 2025 Mick Cook Marine Site Investigation Award.

item.title: Australia’s No Humes Orders First GeoMB Multibeam Echosounder from GeoAcoustics
item.description: GeoAcoustics has announced the first sale of its newly launched GeoMB 401 multibeam echosounder, with the order placed by Australian channel partner No Humes during Oceanology International 2026 in London this week. The sale follows the official launch of GeoMB at the exhibition earlier this week and reflects strong early market interest. The new system marks GeoAcoustics’ entry into the multibeam sector, expanding its established bathymetric sonar portfolio.

item.title: EXMAR Deploys Inmarsat NexusWave to Power Secure Connectivity Across its Fleet
item.description: Inmarsat Maritime, a Viasat company, is rolling out NexusWave across EXMAR’s growing fleet of gas carriers to meet the Belgian shipping company’s evolving commercial and crew connectivity demands.

item.title: RusselSmith and Ghana Maritime Authority in Discussions to Deploy 3D Manufacturing Solutions Across Ghana’s Maritime Sector
item.description: RusselSmith, Nigeria's leading provider of advanced manufacturing and asset integrity solutions, has confirmed discussions with the Ghana Maritime Authority (GMA) regarding the introduction of the company's 3D manufacturing capabilities to Ghana's maritime sector. The growing regional interest in RusselSmith's advanced manufacturing solutions underscores Nigeria's emergence as a credible hub for industrial innovation on the African continent.

item.title: Kongsberg Listen Scores Commercial Breakthrough with DOF HUGIN Order
item.description: Kongsberg Discovery has secured the first commercial order for its newly launched Kongsberg Listen electromagnetic sensing solution. Leading provider of integrated subsea and marine services to the global offshore energy market, DOF, has selected the innovative ‘passive’ technology as part of an integrated payload on a new HUGIN autonomous underwater vehicle (AUV). The landmark agreement was revealed this week at Oceanology International in London.

item.title: FN & Damen Join Forces to Develop Maritime Defense Solutions
item.description: Damen Shipyards Group has signed a memorandum of understanding (MoU) with FN Herstal, laying the foundation for a strategic industrial participation in maritime defense. With this, the two parties aim to collaborate closely on the integration of FN solutions with Damen vessels, and the development of the regional, European and NATO defense eco-systems.

item.title: FreeStar Delivers Rapid Multi-Technology Cable Survey for TenneT
item.description: FreeStar Subsea Services and its project partner Seekable have successfully completed a subsea survey campaign for transmission system operator TenneT, mobilizing multiple survey technologies aboard FreeStar’s vessel Navicula Star to inspect power cables off the Dutch coast.

item.title: New Research Shows US Offshore Wind Could Drive $42 Billion Expansion in Domestic Steel Sector
item.description: Emerging research from Oceantic Network reveals that the continued buildout of US offshore wind energy represents a transformational opportunity to expand the American steel industry, boost domestic fabrication capacity, and strengthen US economic and energy security.
